site_area_sqm.formula: Area of submitted provisional SITE-001 projected from EPSG:4326 to EPSG:4548.

key_area_count.formula: Count of submitted provisional KEY_AREA features.

key_area_area_sqm.formula: Sum of three submitted provisional KEY_AREA geometries in EPSG:4548.

land_use_area_sqm.formula: Union area of six conceptual LAND_USE features after projecting each feature to EPSG:4548, clipped to submitted SITE_BOUNDARY.

land_use_coverage_ratio.formula: Projected LAND_USE union area inside submitted SITE_BOUNDARY divided by projected SITE_BOUNDARY area.

building_footprint_area_sqm.formula: Sum of 12 conceptual prototype footprints in EPSG:4548.

building_coverage_ratio.formula: Conceptual prototype footprint area divided by submitted SITE_BOUNDARY area; not an official BCR.

green_space_area_sqm.formula: Union area of conceptual GREEN_SPACE features in EPSG:4548.

green_ratio.formula: Conceptual GREEN_SPACE union area divided by submitted SITE_BOUNDARY area; not an official planning green ratio.

public_space_area_sqm.formula: Union area of 12 conceptual neighbor-station PUBLIC_SPACE features in EPSG:4548.

public_space_ratio.formula: Conceptual PUBLIC_SPACE union area divided by submitted SITE_BOUNDARY area.

road_centerline_length_m.formula: Sum of conceptual ROAD_CENTERLINE feature lengths in EPSG:4548.

walking_cycling_length_m.formula: All submitted roads are conceptual greenway, pedestrian, or cycleway centerlines; sum in EPSG:4548.

neighbor_station_count.formula: Count of PUBLIC_SPACE features with PS- prefix.

scenario_card_count.formula: Count of SCN-01 through SCN-12 scenario cards in the frozen content contract.

industry_test_scenario_count.formula: Count of testing scenarios SCN-05, SCN-07, SCN-08, and SCN-09.

persona_count.formula: Count of PERSONA-01 through PERSONA-06 in the frozen content contract.

landmark_count.formula: Count of conceptual institutional landmarks mapped to PS-ZY-01, PS-AO-01, and PS-DZ-04.

phase_area_sqm.formula: Union area of A/B/C evidence-gated phase features after projecting each feature to EPSG:4548, clipped to submitted SITE_BOUNDARY.

floor_area_ratio.formula: Requires approved regulatory planning conditions and verified total floor area.
floor_area_ratio.reason: Official floor-area-ratio controls and verified building floor area are unavailable.

building_height_m.formula: Requires approved height controls and heritage, aviation, fire, and engineering review.
building_height_m.reason: Official height controls and specialist constraints are unavailable.

official_green_ratio.formula: Requires approved regulatory planning conditions; distinct from the conceptual green_ratio metric.
official_green_ratio.reason: Official planning green-ratio control is unavailable.
